pair_network.description: Pair the lamp into one of your networks, or create a new network with new keys.

pair.title: Pair a lamp
pair.description: Hold the mode button of the lamp until it blinks: it is then in pairing mode for up to 6 minutes. Keep the lamp close to a Bluetooth proxy. Pairing resets the lamp into this network: it leaves Smart Life. Lamp: {address}.

manual.title: Add a lamp with existing mesh keys
manual.description: Add a lamp without resetting it. A lamp of a configured mesh network is added to that network. Otherwise a new network is created: set its existing mesh keys in Options. Without keys the integration stays in observation mode.

existing.title: Add a lamp that is already in this network
existing.description: Select a nearby lamp or enter its Bluetooth address. 'This network' means the lamp advertises the Network ID of these keys. A lamp with a low battery advertises only Node Identity and shows 'network not verified'. The mesh address is detected on the first connection.

restore.title: Restore an interrupted pairing
restore.description: Pairing of this lamp ended after the lamp joined the network, for example by a restart. The lamp is added with its stored DeviceKey; then use Reconfigure, Finish configuration.

init.title: Mesh network
init.description: Choose observe for passive diagnostics, query_only for reads, vendor_dp for experimental Tuya DP control or sig for SIG light models. Use existing keys and a dedicated unused unicast controller address (decimal input). Confirm this address has never been used by Smart Life or another controller. Keys are stored locally in HA config entry storage, without additional encryption; protect backups. Import: select the existing entry and submit; keys and metadata are prefilled locally, and the mesh address and DeviceKey are stored with that lamp. The original integration is unchanged. Previous controller address: {previous_source}; do not reuse it. A dedicated unused address is still required.

profile.title: Confirmed light metadata
profile.description: Leave unknown settings disabled. Without confirmed endpoints, colour temperature uses 2000–6500 K, the range Home Assistant's Tuya integration used for this lamp. HSV must use the 12-hex-character format. Scene replay sends only previously received DP6 values.
